name: 2.4GHz Wireless Radio Transceiver
description: Like walkie-talkies for microcontrollers! Sends packet data wirelessly over 2.4GHz ISM band.
realWorldAnalogy: Like walkie-talkies for microcontrollers! Sends packet data wirelessly over 2.4GHz ISM band.

hazards: Requires strictly regulated 3.3V; 5V will permanently destroy module
safety.childSafeAlternative: Always connect VCC to 3.3V pin with 10uF filter capacitor

wiringGuidance: Connect GND (Dark Slate) to GND, VCC (Red) to 3.3V ONLY, CE (Orange) to Pin 9, CSN (Orange) to Pin 10, SCK (Orange) to Pin 13, MOSI (Orange) to Pin 11, MISO (Orange) to Pin 12.
commonMistakes: Powering VCC with 5V permanently destroys the RF chip!
Noisy 3.3V power rails causing packet drops (add a 10uF capacitor across VCC and GND).

miniExperiment.title: RF Transmitter Beacon
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 3.3V, GND to GND, CE to 9, CSN to 10, SCK to 13, MOSI to 11, MISO to 12.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Transmits 2.4GHz wireless telemetry packets once per second.
